sessions.phase_label: Master style system and initial template implementation
Interactive-field redesign and Word-template package completion
Customer feedback corrections and PowerPoint-template exploration
Final Word-template review and PowerPoint-template engagement

requirements.title: Danish Default Template Language
requirements.definition: Configure the Word templates to use Danish as their default document language.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers Word language configuration, not the separate wording of style names, field labels, or placeholders.

requirements.title: Danish Field Labels and Placeholder Text
requirements.definition: Present user-facing field labels and placeholder instructions in Danish using the approved field-specific wording.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers visible Danish field text; field activation, help persistence, and control technology are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Complete Word Style Catalog
requirements.definition: Implement the supplied style system across the applicable templates, including all required active paragraph, list, table, image-text, and related styles.
requirements.boundary_note: Represents completeness and consistent availability of the style catalog; individual list behavior, typography, colors, and caption formatting remain independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Word Style Naming Convention
requirements.definition: Apply the approved naming convention to active Word styles, including localized names and any adopted NXQ prefix.
requirements.boundary_note: Style naming can change without changing the visual or functional behavior of the styles themselves; the NXQ prefix remains conditional in the initial brief.

requirements.title: Title and Heading Typography
requirements.definition: Maintain the approved typography for title and heading styles, including a 40pt title and a bold Heading 3 without changing its size.
requirements.boundary_note: The typography values are attributes of the related title/heading style mechanism rather than separate Requirements for each font property.

requirements.title: Image and Table Caption Style
requirements.definition: Provide a caption style for image and table labels using the approved 11/15-point, italic Century Gothic formatting.
requirements.boundary_note: Caption typography and naming form one coupled style definition; control-field labels are a different behavior.

requirements.title: Controlled Theme Color Palette
requirements.definition: Include the required theme colors while restricting users to the approved color palette rather than exposing all available colors.
requirements.boundary_note: Color availability is independently configurable and is not merged with typography or bullet behavior.

requirements.title: Tab-Driven List Hierarchy
requirements.definition: Allow users to create clean, consistently aligned list sub-levels with the Tab key throughout the relevant list styles.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers hierarchy and indentation behavior; bullet appearance and multi-digit numbering alignment can fail independently.

requirements.title: Graphic Bullet Visual Design
requirements.definition: Render bullets with the supplied design, proportional sizing, balanced appearance, vertical alignment, and natural scaling with text size.
requirements.boundary_note: Visual bullet rendering is separate from list-level navigation and numbering alignment.

requirements.title: Multi-Digit Numbered-List Alignment
requirements.definition: Keep numbered-list text and markers correctly aligned when numbering reaches two or more digits.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a distinct list-layout acceptance criterion that can fail even when Tab-based hierarchy works.

requirements.title: Enter-Key Bullet Creation
requirements.definition: Create a new bullet automatically when the user presses Enter in the designated controlled bullet area.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers bullet continuation inside the designated list control, not general multiline text entry in ordinary fields.

requirements.title: Legacy Content Paste Stability
requirements.definition: Keep styles and overall formatting stable when users move content from legacy NXQ templates into the new templates.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers general pasted-content formatting stability; table containment and post-paste line-break behavior have separate acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Pasted Table and Column Containment
requirements.definition: Keep pasted tables and right-hand columns structurally intact and within the document page margins.
requirements.boundary_note: Table and column containment can fail independently of general style preservation during paste.

requirements.title: Post-Paste Manual Line Breaks
requirements.definition: Allow users to create reliable manual line breaks after content has been pasted from legacy documents.
requirements.boundary_note: This is specifically the post-paste behavior; general Enter-key availability and paragraph spacing are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Robust Field Implementation Architecture
requirements.definition: Use a robust field setup in which ordinary editable text does not rely on inappropriate legacy developer fields while specialized controls remain available where functionally needed.
requirements.boundary_note: Represents the underlying field-technology decision; concrete dropdown, checklist, date, placeholder, and labeling behaviors remain separate.

requirements.title: Field Placeholder Activation Behavior
requirements.definition: Let users activate a field and begin entering replacement content without manually selecting and deleting its existing placeholder text.
requirements.boundary_note: Activation and replacement behavior is independently testable from whether help text remains available after entry.

requirements.title: Persistent Field Labels and Help Text
requirements.definition: Give every control field a unique label matching its initial in-field instruction and preserve that original purpose as accessible help after users replace the field content.
requirements.boundary_note: Label text, uniqueness, and persistent help are attributes of one field-guidance mechanism; placeholder clearing is separate.

requirements.title: Visible Editable-Field Cues
requirements.definition: Make editable areas visibly identifiable to users without depending on inconsistent or inapplicable legacy grey-field behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers visual discoverability of editable fields, not the underlying choice between plain text and content-control technology.

requirements.title: Interactive Field Formatting Preservation
requirements.definition: Preserve the intended field typography and formatting when a user activates or edits an interactive field.
requirements.boundary_note: Formatting preservation is an independent failure mode from placeholder clearing or field visibility.

requirements.title: Field Text Wrapping and Column Stability
requirements.definition: Wrap overflowing text inside the designated field or text box without pushing adjacent columns beyond their intended positions.
requirements.boundary_note: Automatic wrapping and horizontal containment can fail independently of whether Enter is accepted inside the field.

requirements.title: Regular Enter and Multiline Field Input
requirements.definition: Allow ordinary Enter-based multiline input in every field designated for multiple lines, including applicable item, date, and headline fields.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers whether regular Enter is accepted; line spacing after a return and automatic numbered-row creation are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Reusable Date Field Control
requirements.definition: Provide the approved reusable date-entry behavior, including calendar-style selection where adopted and day/month/year formatting across the requested templates.
requirements.boundary_note: Calendar behavior, date format, and reuse are attributes of one date-entry mechanism; general multiline support is tracked separately.

requirements.title: Checklist and Dropdown Controls
requirements.definition: Retain or provide functional checklist and dropdown controls in templates where users must select structured values.
requirements.boundary_note: Structured selection controls remain independent from ordinary text-field architecture and date entry.

requirements.title: Document Spacing and Page Fit
requirements.definition: Use compact, readable spacing so the applicable document content fits within the required page count.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers overall document density and page fit, not local field padding or paragraph-return behavior.

requirements.title: Page Numbering Begins on Page Two
requirements.definition: Omit the footer page number from the first page and begin visible page numbering on page two.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a self-contained page-numbering rule rather than a general footer or page-layout Requirement.

requirements.title: Guidance Template Fixed Margins
requirements.definition: Keep the Guidance template's designated section within fixed margins so adjacent visual elements such as the pencil icon are not clipped.
requirements.boundary_note: The fixed-margin behavior is scoped to the affected Guidance layout and can fail independently of general page fit.

requirements.title: Text-to-Border Padding
requirements.definition: Maintain sufficient internal spacing so text does not touch the right-hand line or border in the affected table and field areas.
requirements.boundary_note: Local padding is independently configurable from overall document spacing and fixed external margins.

requirements.title: Continuous-Text Return Spacing
requirements.definition: Make normal paragraph returns produce suitable spacing for continuous text rather than the excessive spacing intended between bullet items.
requirements.boundary_note: This governs the visual result of a return; the ability to enter a return at all is tracked by the multiline-field Requirement.

requirements.title: Board Meeting Field Alignment
requirements.definition: Align the Item and Title fields on the same line as Topic, Proposal, and Start Time in the Board Meeting template.
requirements.boundary_note: Field alignment is visually and technically independent from the workflow for adding new rows.

requirements.title: Board Meeting Row Insertion Workflow
requirements.definition: Support the approved workflow for adding Board Meeting items by inserting a row, copying the required fields, and editing it without unintended borders or lines.
requirements.boundary_note: Captures the accepted row-addition mechanism and its formatting integrity rather than treating Enter-based automatic numbering as a separate accepted requirement.

requirements.title: Modern Word for Windows Reliability
requirements.definition: Keep the templates technically reliable and consistently rendered for real users on current Microsoft Word versions for Windows.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the operating-environment and cross-user compatibility constraint; it must not absorb specific style, paste, field, or layout failures.

requirements.title: Master Template Table Operability
requirements.definition: Ensure that users can use the Master template's table elements without the tables breaking or making the document unusable.
requirements.boundary_note: This concerns ordinary operation of Master-template tables, not the separate containment of tables pasted from legacy documents.

requirements.title: Master Template Text Duplication Prevention
requirements.definition: Prevent Master-template elements from unexpectedly duplicating user text during ordinary use.
requirements.boundary_note: Text duplication is a distinct observed failure from table malfunction and can require a different correction path.

requirements.title: Customer-Designed PowerPoint Template
requirements.definition: Create a PowerPoint template from scratch using the customer-supplied slide designs, typography, branding assets, and approved layout system.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers faithful construction of the supplied slide-layout system; dynamic user-added bullet behavior is independently testable and remains separate.

requirements.title: Dynamic PowerPoint Bullet Layout
requirements.definition: Support practical user-added bullet content while preserving the intended slide layout and adjusting text size or spacing when content exceeds the designed count.
requirements.boundary_note: This behavior can fail independently of whether the static slide designs and brand assets are implemented correctly.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client requires Danish as the default template language, while the freelancer says the document will default to English and offers Danish style names instead. It is unclear whether the client's broad acceptance accepts that limitation or only the localized naming proposal.
Preventing accidental deletion of content-control fields is proposed and explained, but no supplied client message clearly accepts or rejects it.

PowerPoint decisions about 16:9 image backgrounds, logo placement on every slide, splash-image mask behavior, and whether 72/88 denotes line height remain framed as design questions rather than confirmed requirements.

The desired behavior for resizing PowerPoint content or checkbox areas is not fully recoverable from the supplied messages; the freelancer reports that a table-style layout is impossible and suggests manual handling.
